proposals.label: A valid bar chart
proposals.note: A well-formed proposal: it validates, carries no error diagnostics, and fits the data. The loop returns ok — and only then do we paint.

proposals.label: Missing a required prop
proposals.note: A stacked bar with no stackBy. Validation rejects it before render — the agent gets a precise reason to retry, not a chart that paints as a plain bar and silently drops the stacking the user asked for.

proposals.label: Wrong chart for the data
proposals.note: A scatterplot wants two numeric axes; region is categorical. The fit check refuses and ranks alternatives, so the agent re-proposes the right chart instead of misleading the reader with a degenerate scatter.

proposals.label: An invented component
proposals.note: A hallucinated component name. It isn't in the registry, so no config is built and no JSX is emitted — the loop hands back alternatives instead.
